title: Dxcufgb's Familiar Faces
description: A sidebar tab of everyone the party has met. The GM selects a name in any journal and right-clicks it to add that NPC, and right-clicks journal images to give them a portrait. Players keep their own notes about each NPC, with where they met them, and keep each note private, share it with the party or with chosen players. Search everyone and group them by place.
